info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Weather Alerts Settings-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Settings API provides users with access to their personalized weather alert preferences. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve current settings for weather alerts, facilitating users in managing notifications based on their locations and preferences. Typical consumers include individual users and application developers looking to integrate alert settings into their applications. This API ensures users stay informed about relevant weather changes while maintaining control over their alert configurations.

get.description: Fetch the current settings for alerts, allowing users to understand their configuration and make necessary adjustments. This endpoint provides details about thresholds, notifications, and other relevant parameters related to alert systems.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving alert settings. This endpoint allows the client to specify parameters for fetching the current configuration of alert settings in JSON format.
